limitations: No validated combined wicket/run-equivalent model: rankings use contextual run residuals and publish wickets separately. Strict margin coverage failed; the fallback is not a validated superior pressure measure.
Primary model is linear logistic; quadratic candidate evaluated but no superiority claim or automatic selection.
Margin labels are an operational hypothesis; no psychological pressure ground truth. Stress support/extrapolation validation is pending.
First-innings median benchmark is a modelling assumption; first/chase figures are separate. Overall run residual ranking pools their exposure without claiming identical viability scales.
Opponent strength, venue effects, hierarchical season effects and supported pace/spin comparisons are not yet fitted.
Player estimates use fixed exposure shrinkage and match bootstrap, not a fitted hierarchical posterior.

2026 holdout metrics are reported; models and policy were developed in this implementation, not prospectively preregistered. Policy comparisons are retrospective and not confirmatory evidence of superiority.
Auction availability, 2027 rules, purse and submission dropdown IDs are unverified. No actionable TARGET list is asserted.
Overall ranks compare observed player exposure. Pairwise comparisons instead standardise over shared innings/phase/IPL strata with match-cluster intervals; venue/opponent/position confounds remain.
